payload.function_structure:
OVERALL FUNCTION: carry a pending decision, intact and readable, to whoever must make it - and say so when it cannot.

SUB-FUNCTIONS, verb + noun, solution-neutral:
- F1 decide the mode: determine whether a person or the system itself will adjudicate this decision.
- F2 read the current pairing: obtain the delivery settings as they are at the moment of sending, not as they were at startup.
- F3 compose the record of the decision: assemble what is being decided and the evidence behind it into one self-contained readable thing.
- F4 conceal the content: render that thing unreadable to whoever stores it, while keeping it readable to whoever holds the reference.
- F5 place the content: put it where the recipient's device can retrieve it.
- F6 confirm retrievability: establish that it can actually be fetched before anyone is told about it.
- F7 bound the lifetime: ensure it stops being retrievable no later than the decision it serves stops mattering.
- F8 compose the summons: build the short message that reaches the person, marked so a decision is distinguishable from a remark.
- F9 offer the answers: attach the ways to answer, each addressed so the device can actually act on it, within the budget the channel allows.
- F10 attach the reference: include the pointer to the composed record when one exists.
- F11 deliver the summons: send it.
- F12 degrade deliberately: when the record cannot be placed or confirmed, still deliver an answerable summons.
- F13 report the attempt: record whether the person was reached, in a place both the system and the person can see.
- F14 withhold the credential: keep the store's credential out of every record, message and artifact.
- F15 receive the answer: read the reply and bind it to the decision it names.
payload.coverage:
REQUIREMENT -> FUNCTION, no holes: R1 -> F9. R2 -> F8. R3 -> F9, F10. R4 -> F3. R5 -> F4. R6 -> F6. R7 -> F7. R8 -> F12. R9 -> F1. R10 -> F2. R11 -> F14. R12 -> F13. Q1 -> F12, F13 together (an actionable summons or a recorded failure, never neither). D1 -> the whole chain exercised on a device, F1 through F15.

USE-CASE STEP -> FUNCTION: UC-A 1 -> F1; 2 -> F2; 3 -> F3; 4 -> F4, F5, F7; 5 -> F6; 6 -> F8, F9, F10, F11; 7 -> F13. UC-A ext 1a -> F1; 2a -> F2; 4a -> F12; 5a -> F6, F12; 6a -> F13. UC-B 1-2 -> the recipient's own act, outside the system; 3 -> the channel; 4 -> F15. UC-C 1-3 -> F4 (its inverse, performed by the reader). UC-D -> F7.

F4 and F7 are deliberately separate: concealing content and bounding its lifetime are different guarantees, and a system that conceals but never expires still accumulates a readable archive for whoever holds the references. F12 and F13 are likewise separate - degrading without reporting is exactly the failure this iteration exists to remove.
